changeSet.author: CredibleX
changeSet.sql: UPDATE m_savings_account_transaction tx SET associated_loan_id = d.from_loan_account_id FROM m_account_transfer_transaction att JOIN m_account_transfer_details d ON d.id = att.account_transfer_details_id WHERE att.to_savings_transaction_id = tx.id AND d.from_loan_account_id IS NOT NULL AND tx.associated_loan_id IS NULL

changeSet.author: CredibleX
changeSet.sql: UPDATE m_savings_account_transaction tx SET associated_loan_id = src.loan_id, associated_from_installment = src.from_installment, associated_to_installment = src.to_installment FROM ( SELECT att.from_savings_transaction_id AS savings_tx_id, d.to_loan_account_id AS loan_id, MIN(CASE WHEN pl.short_name = 'RBF' THEN rs.installment END) AS from_installment, MAX(CASE WHEN pl.short_name = 'RBF' THEN rs.installment END) AS to_installment FROM m_account_transfer_transaction att JOIN m_account_transfer_details d ON d.id = att.account_transfer_details_id JOIN m_loan l ON l.id = d.to_loan_account_id JOIN m_product_loan pl ON pl.id = l.product_id LEFT JOIN m_loan_transaction_repayment_schedule_mapping map ON map.loan_transaction_id = att.to_loan_transaction_id LEFT JOIN m_loan_repayment_schedule rs ON rs.id = map.loan_repayment_schedule_id WHERE att.from_savings_transaction_id IS NOT NULL AND d.to_loan_account_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY att.from_savings_transaction_id, d.to_loan_account_id ) src WHERE tx.id = src.savings_tx_id AND tx.associated_loan_id IS NULL

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stretchy_report WHERE report_name = 'Savings Accounts Transactions Report'

update.column: SELECT c.id AS "Client Id", CONCAT(c.firstname, ' ', COALESCE(c.middlename, ''), ' ', COALESCE(c.lastname, '')) AS "Client Name", sa.id AS "Saving Account Id", sa.account_no AS "Savings account no.", t.id AS "Transaction Id", to_char(COALESCE(t.submitted_on_date, t.created_date::date, t.transaction_date), 'DD Month YYYY') AS "Value Date", to_char(t.transaction_date, 'DD Month YYYY') AS "Transaction Date", sa.external_id AS "External Id", CASE t.transaction_type_enum WHEN 1 THEN 'Deposit' WHEN 2 THEN 'Withdrawal' WHEN 3 THEN 'Interest Posting' WHEN 4 THEN 'Withdrawal Fee' WHEN 5 THEN 'Annual Fee' WHEN 12 THEN 'Dividend Payout' WHEN 13 THEN 'Overdraft Interest' WHEN 21 THEN 'Withhold Tax' WHEN 23 THEN 'Charge Reversal' ELSE 'Other' END AS "Parent Transaction Type", CASE t.transaction_sub_type WHEN 1 THEN 'Disbursal' WHEN 2 THEN 'Refund' WHEN 3 THEN 'EMI Transfer' WHEN 4 THEN 'Foreclosure Refund' ELSE NULL END AS "Transaction Sub-Type", CASE WHEN t.transaction_sub_type IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT( CASE t.transaction_type_enum WHEN 1 THEN 'Deposit' WHEN 2 THEN 'Withdrawal' WHEN 3 THEN 'Interest Posting' WHEN 4 THEN 'Withdrawal Fee' WHEN 5 THEN 'Annual Fee' WHEN 12 THEN 'Dividend Payout' WHEN 13 THEN 'Overdraft Interest' WHEN 21 THEN 'Withhold Tax' WHEN 23 THEN 'Charge Reversal' ELSE 'Other' END, ' - ', CASE t.transaction_sub_type WHEN 1 THEN 'Disbursal' WHEN 2 THEN 'Refund' WHEN 3 THEN 'EMI Transfer' WHEN 4 THEN 'Foreclosure Refund' END ) ELSE CASE t.transaction_type_enum WHEN 1 THEN 'Deposit' WHEN 2 THEN 'Withdrawal' WHEN 3 THEN 'Interest Posting' WHEN 4 THEN 'Withdrawal Fee' WHEN 5 THEN 'Annual Fee' WHEN 12 THEN 'Dividend Payout' WHEN 13 THEN 'Overdraft Interest' WHEN 21 THEN 'Withhold Tax' WHEN 23 THEN 'Charge Reversal' ELSE 'Other' END END AS "Transaction Type", CASE WHEN t.associated_loan_id IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN t.associated_from_installment IS NOT NULL AND t.associated_to_installment IS NOT NULL AND t.associated_from_installment = t.associated_to_installment THEN CONCAT(t.associated_loan_id, '-EMI', t.associated_from_installment) WHEN t.associated_from_installment IS NOT NULL AND t.associated_to_installment IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(t.associated_loan_id, '-EMI', t.associated_from_installment, '-', t.associated_to_installment) ELSE CAST(t.associated_loan_id AS TEXT) END AS "Associated Loan", CASE WHEN t.transaction_type_enum IN (2, 4, 5, 13, 21) THEN t.amount ELSE NULL END AS "Debit", CASE WHEN t.transaction_type_enum IN (1, 3, 12, 23) THEN t.amount ELSE NULL END AS "Credit", t.running_balance_derived AS "Balance", pt.value AS "Payment Type" FROM m_savings_account_transaction t JOIN m_savings_account sa ON sa.id = t.savings_account_id JOIN m_client c ON c.id = sa.client_id LEFT JOIN m_payment_detail pd ON pd.id = t.payment_detail_id LEFT JOIN m_payment_type pt ON pt.id = pd.payment_type_id WHERE t.is_reversed = FALSE AND t.transaction_type_enum <> 10 AND (${clientId} = -1 OR c.id = ${clientId}) AND (${savingsId} = -1 OR sa.id = ${savingsId}) AND (pd.payment_type_id IS NULL OR pd.payment_type_id <> 5) ORDER BY c.id ASC, sa.id ASC, t.transaction_date DESC, t.id DESC
